cue.en: Stand up. Inhale, lift shoulders toward your ears; exhale and drop them fully. Repeat.
cue.zh: 站起來。吸氣時把肩膀往耳朵方向抬高，吐氣時完全放下，重複幾次。

cue.en: Soft knees. Hinge at the hips and hang the upper body down. Relax head and neck; feel the hamstrings and low back lengthen.
cue.zh: 膝蓋微彎，從髖部前彎，讓上半身自然垂下，放鬆頭頸，感受大腿後側與下背伸展。

cue.en: Hold a chair. Cross left ankle over right knee, sit the hips back. Feel a stretch deep in the left glute.
cue.zh: 扶著椅子，左腳踝交叉放在右膝上，臀部向後坐，感受左側臀部深層的伸展。

cue.en: Switch sides. Right ankle over left knee, hips back, keep the spine long — no rounding.
cue.zh: 換邊。右腳踝交叉放在左膝上，臀部向後坐，脊椎保持延伸，不要駝背。

cue.en: Big step forward with the left foot into a lunge, back heel lifted, tuck the pelvis slightly. Feel the front of the right hip open.
cue.zh: 左腳向前跨大步呈弓箭步，後腳跟抬起，骨盆微收，感受右髖前側打開。

cue.en: Switch sides. Stay tall through the torso, no shrugging, slow your breathing.
cue.zh: 換邊。上半身保持挺直，肩膀不聳起，呼吸放慢。

cue.en: Feet hip-width, arms crossed over the chest. Slowly rotate the torso left and right, letting the eyes follow.
cue.zh: 雙腳與髖同寬，雙手抱胸，緩慢左右旋轉上半身，眼睛跟著轉動方向看。

cue.en: Rest your right hand gently on the left side of the head, ease the head toward the right shoulder, left shoulder down. Switch sides, then return to your desk.
cue.zh: 右手輕放在頭部左側，慢慢將頭往右肩靠近，左肩下沉。換邊後再回到座位。

cue.en: Place forearms on a doorframe (or clasp hands behind your back), step forward and open the chest. Feel the stretch across the chest and front shoulders.
cue.zh: 前臂靠在門框上（或雙手於背後交扣），身體向前傾展開胸口，感受胸部與肩前側的伸展。

cue.en: Extend one arm, palm up, gently pull the fingers back with the other hand. Then flip palm down and repeat. Switch arms.
cue.zh: 一手向前伸直、掌心朝上，另一手輕輕將手指往後扳。再翻掌心朝下重複，換手進行。

cue.en: Rise onto your toes and lower slowly a few times, then lift one foot and circle the ankle both directions. Switch feet.
cue.zh: 踮腳尖後緩慢放下，重複幾次；接著抬起一腳，腳踝雙向繞圈，換腳進行。
